name: The Comparison Arena — extreme scale & comparison showdowns
_channel: The Comparison Arena (@TheComparisonArena). High-octane broadcast comparisons: 1v1 title-fights, 1-to-100 escalation ladders, and high-stakes auction bidding wars, narrated with the frantic energy of a football commentator and auctioneer. Tagline: 'Every scale pushed to the absolute limit.' Sign-off: 'And the numbers have settled it.'
_origin: Created 2026-08-17 to power universal extreme comparison videos (richest, fastest, tallest, largest, aliens, cosmic scales, GOAT athletes, military showdowns).
audience: global curious & competitive audience 16-35. Argumentative, thrill-seeking, data-fascinated, comment-active.

showdown_1v1.format_name: 1v1 Showdown — Head-to-Head Clash (long-form 6-10 min, or Short 45-60s)

structure.note: High-octane opening stinger. Start at maximum tension with a score or lead change teaser. Zero generic intro.
Establish combatants, arena parameters, and stakes in rapid commentator cadence.
Initial baseline comparison. Fast pace, rapid stat punch.
Escalation round where combatants push into extreme territory. First lead change / tension spike.
The most contested category (insane metric). High drama, auctioneer staccato pacing.
The mind-bending ultimate metric. Double stakes. Crowning moment.
Commentator recap, belt handover, subscribe CTA + 'Who should fight next?' comment prompt. Sign-off.

escalation_ladder.format_name: The Escalation Ladder — 1-to-100 Scale Climb (long-form 8-15 min, or Short 50-60s)

title.formula: [CATEGORY] Size / Wealth / Speed Comparison: [Level 1 to Level 100]

structure.note: 15-second FOMO hook: 'Level 1 starts simple, but by Level 8 things get illegal, and Level 10 will break your brain.'
Levels 1-3: Relatable human scale. Rapid-fire commentary.
Levels 4-6: Global/planetary scale. Rising tempo, dynamic speedup.
Levels 7-9: Insane, mind-bending territory. Staccato delivery.
Level 10 / Final Form: Beyond human comprehension. Extreme climax.
Scale recap, CTA to subscribe, question of the day.

auction_bidding_war.format_name: The High-Stakes Auction — Net Worth & Price Showdown (long-form 5-8 min, or Short 45-60s)

title.formula: [ASSET / ENTITY] Bidding War: [The Insane Price Race]

stakes: The Most Expensive Asset on Earth

structure.note: Gavel strike open: 'Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the floor. Today we auction the rarest, richest assets in the galaxy!'
First item/combatant on the block. Fast auctioneer cadence.
Escalating bids, counter-bids, rapid numbers climbing on screen.
The billionaire clash. Gavel warning: 'Fair warning... going once... going twice...'
SOLD! Final evaluation, winner takes all, viewer CTA.

moment_classes._note: THE COMMENTARY IP. Keyed by data conditions to trigger specific commentator and auctioneer delivery registers.

phrases: Welcome to the ultimate arena. The numbers are in, and what you are about to witness is insane.
They said this comparison was impossible. They were wrong. Let's run the data!
Level one looks harmless. Level ten will shatter everything you think you know.
Ladies and gentlemen, take your seats. The greatest showdown in history starts RIGHT NOW!

C1_AUCTION_BID.trigger: Rapid price/metric climb or bidding war
C1_AUCTION_BID.delivery: Auctioneer staccato, fast syllables, rhythmic chant
phrases: Fifty billion on the left, do I hear seventy-five? Seventy-five to Apple, now one hundred billion!
Going up, climbing fast! Look at the ticker race past two hundred million!
Can anybody match that bid? We have three hundred billion on the board and climbing!
Going once! Going twice! The numbers are skyrocketing!

C2_LADDER_CLIMB.trigger: Stepping up to the next tier of scale
phrases: You thought that was big? We are just getting started. Step up to Level [N]!
Now we enter insane territory. Look at how small the last level looks compared to THIS.
The scale just exploded. Multiply that by ten thousand and you get [NAME]!
We have officially left human comprehension behind!

C3_GOAL_CLIMAX.trigger: Sudden breakthrough, overtake, or decisive score
C3_GOAL_CLIMAX.delivery: Football commentator peak roar, maximum volume and energy
phrases: AND HE BREAKS AWAY! LOOK AT THE NUMBERS CLIMB — IT'S IN! UNBELIEVABLE!
OVERTAKE! [NAME] STORMS INTO FIRST PLACE WITH PURE MOMENTUM!
WHAT A STRIKE! The competition is left in the dust!
IT'S A GOAL! ABSOLUTE SCENES IN THE ARENA AS [NAME] TAKES THE LEAD!

C4_MIND_BENDER.trigger: An incomprehensibly vast statistic or scale ratio
phrases: Put this into perspective. If you stacked every single one end to end, it would reach the Moon and back twice.
If you spent a million dollars every single day since the dawn of human history, you still wouldn't match [NAME].
That is not just a lead — that is an entire universe of difference.
Let that number sink in. Look at the chart. It doesn't even fit on the screen!

C5_GAVEL_SLAM.trigger: Final round, round win, or auction conclusion
phrases: GOING ONCE... GOING TWICE... SOLD TO [NAME] AT [VALUE]!
THE GAVEL COMES DOWN! The champion has been crowned!
THAT IS THE FINAL WHISTLE! The debate is officially over!
And the numbers have settled it.

C6_PHOTO_FINISH.trigger: Separation between top two is under 2%
phrases: Look at the margin! They are neck and neck, separated by a razor-thin fraction!
Too close to call! We are going down to the final millimeter!
A photo finish! In twenty years of broadcasting, we have never seen a race this tight!
WAIT A SECOND! Look at the chaser! THE GIANT HAS BEEN TOPPLED!
NOBODY SAW THIS COMING! The underdog just destroyed the record book!
THE CROWD IS IN SHOCK! [NAME] takes down the undisputed titan!

voice_rules: Permanent channel voice: 'THE ARENA COMMENTATOR' — energetic, sharp, lightning-fast articulation.
Target voiceover pace: 4.5 to 6.5 words per second during action sequences; 3.5 words/sec during dramatic pauses.
Dynamic silence: 0.3s to 0.7s before major reveals and gavel strikes.
Number rounding in speech: Round to 3 significant digits in speech ('342 billion', '9.4 million'), while on-screen charts render full precision.
Every video enforces the Two-Source Rule for verified data points.
